title: Impossible travel followed by privileged mailbox rule creation
description: A privileged user authenticated from Singapore and Germany within 18 minutes, then created an external forwarding mailbox rule.
evidence: Successful sign-in from 203.0.113.84 using unfamiliar ASN
Successful sign-in from 198.51.100.18 using compliant device claim
New-InboxRule created to forward invoices to external recipient
User has Global Reader and Exchange Administrator roles
recommended_actions: Revoke active sessions and reset credentials
Search for similar forwarding rules across tenant

title: Endpoint ransomware behavior detected on finance workstation
description: A workstation executed a process tree associated with rapid file renaming, shadow copy deletion, and suspicious encryption extensions.
evidence: powershell.exe launched vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet
2,412 files renamed with .locked extension in 6 minutes
Suspicious parent process winword.exe spawned powershell.exe
Outbound connection to newly observed domain updates-sync.example
recommended_actions: Collect memory and disk forensic package
Block observed domain and hash indicators
Verify backup integrity for impacted file shares

title: Suspicious OAuth consent grant for mail.read permissions
description: A newly registered application requested tenant-wide mail permissions after being consented by a user outside the approved publisher list.
evidence: Application created by external user invite
Requested scopes include Mail.Read, offline_access, User.Read
Consent granted from unmanaged device
No verified publisher configured

title: Multiple failed VPN attempts followed by successful login
description: A user account had 27 failed VPN login attempts from three countries before a successful login using the same client version.
evidence: Successful login from 45.83.64.21 after password spray pattern
No MFA fatigue prompts reported
User does not normally authenticate outside Eastern Europe
recommended_actions: Validate user activity during VPN session

title: Rare PowerShell encoded command on developer workstation
description: An encoded PowerShell command ran from a temporary directory on a developer workstation shortly after a browser download.
evidence: powershell.exe -EncodedCommand observed with 1,204 byte payload
Parent process chrome.exe downloaded build-helper.zip
Script contacted raw.githubusercontent.example path
No lateral movement observed after execution
recommended_actions: Hunt for same command line across fleet

title: Blocked malware attachment delivered to executive mailbox
description: A phishing email with a known malware attachment was blocked before delivery to an executive mailbox.
evidence: Attachment hash matched known malware signature
Safe Attachments detonated payload and blocked delivery
No user click activity recorded
Sender domain failed DMARC alignment
recommended_actions: Verify no similar messages bypassed protection
Submit sender indicators to block list
Keep alert closed if no delivery found
